home_description.message: Introspectum builds software you can check: a verified software factory, an open-data ERP and CRM, and research in systematic trading.
home_description.description: Meta description of the homepage, shown in search results and link previews.

home_share_title.message: Software that is checked instead of trusted.
home_share_title.description: Large line on the homepage's link-preview image (LinkedIn, social media).

home_hook_source.message: Sonar, State of Code Developer Survey 2026
home_hook_source.description: Source of the opening line: publisher and report title. Report titles stay in their original language.

home_why_label.description: Homepage section label: why the company exists.

home_why_text.message: AI writes a growing share of all code, faster than anyone can review it. We build software that is checked instead of trusted: traced from requirement to code, proven where it matters, and open to the people who answer for it.

home_what_label.description: Homepage section label above the products and consulting.

home_how_label.description: Homepage section label above the methods and principles.

home_who_text.message: Introspectum Limited is registered in the Isle of Man and led by Fabian Klopfer, a computer scientist and former software engineer at IBM Germany Research & Development.
home_who_text.description: Homepage: who runs the company, one sentence. Also the About page's meta description.

home_who_more.description: Link from the homepage to the About page.

principle_traceability.description: Principle, one list item: every line of code traces back to a requirement.

consulting_name.description: Name of the consulting offer, shown like a product name on the homepage and as a section label.

consulting_what.message: Until our products ship, we help companies bring AI into their software development and set up CRM and ERP.
consulting_what.description: What the consulting offer is, one sentence.

consulting_audience.message: For companies that want to use AI without losing control of their code or their data.
consulting_audience.description: Who the consulting offer is for, one sentence.

consulting_link.description: Link that opens an email to the company.

consulting_subject.description: Subject line of the email the consulting link opens.

products_title.description: Title of the product overview page.

products_intro.message: Three products, all before release. Join a waiting list to test one first.
products_intro.description: Opening line of the product overview; also its meta description and link-preview title.

status_prototype.description: Product status shown under the product name: a working prototype.

status_in_development.description: Product status shown under the product name.

status_research.description: Product status shown under the product name: research, not a product yet.

product_software_factory_name.description: Product name. Fixed term in every language (glossary).

product_software_factory_what.message: Builds one graph from your code and documents, lets AI agents work on it, and checks their changes with formal verification.
product_software_factory_what.description: What the Software Factory does, one sentence. Also its link-preview title and meta description.

product_software_factory_audience.message: For software teams that use AI to write code and must stand behind it, starting with startups and small IT companies.
product_software_factory_audience.description: Who the Software Factory is for, one sentence.

product_software_factory_detail_1.message: The Software Factory reads your code and its documents into one graph: requirements, design, tests, bug reports and analysis results, each linked to the code it concerns. You see the system as architecture maps, from the overview down to single functions.
product_software_factory_detail_1.description: Software Factory page, paragraph 1 of 3: the graph and the maps.

product_software_factory_detail_2.message: On top of the graph, AI agents work in steps modelled on ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288, the standard for system life cycle processes, and formal verification checks their output against your specifications. Every step leaves an audit trail.
product_software_factory_detail_2.description: Software Factory page, paragraph 2 of 3: the agent process and verification.

product_software_factory_detail_3.message: The graph and the maps work today, and verification runs end to end with the Prusti and Verus verifiers. The agent process comes next.
product_software_factory_detail_3.description: Software Factory page, paragraph 3 of 3: what works now. Prusti and Verus are tool names.

product_erp_crm_name.description: Product name. Fixed term in every language (glossary). Contains no-break spaces so it never splits across lines.

product_erp_crm_what.message: Customers, sales, accounting and HR in one open-data system, with an AI assistant that works on the same data.
product_erp_crm_what.description: What the ERP & CRM does, one sentence. Also its link-preview title and meta description.

product_erp_crm_audience.message: For small businesses that still run on paper and spreadsheets, starting with real estate and IT services.
product_erp_crm_audience.description: Who the ERP & CRM is for, one sentence.

product_erp_crm_detail_1.message: An ERP and CRM built on Twenty, the open-source CRM, and extended with accounting, tax, purchasing, sales, payments, inventory and HR.
product_erp_crm_detail_1.description: ERP & CRM page, paragraph 1 of 3: what it is built on. Twenty is a product name.

product_erp_crm_detail_2.message: Each customer gets its own installation, and all data stays in open formats in one place. An AI assistant works on the same data as your team: it can keep records in order, prepare analyses and draft documents.
product_erp_crm_detail_2.description: ERP & CRM page, paragraph 2 of 3: data ownership and the assistant.

product_erp_crm_detail_3.message: Our own company and a real-estate brokerage are its first users.
product_erp_crm_detail_3.description: ERP & CRM page, paragraph 3 of 3: first users.

product_trading_platform_name.description: Product name. Fixed term in every language (glossary).

product_trading_platform_what.message: Runs trend-following strategies on many stocks at once, with reinforcement learning tuning each stock’s settings.
product_trading_platform_what.description: What the Trading Platform does, one sentence. Also its link-preview title and meta description.

product_trading_platform_audience.message: For investors from real estate, banking and IT who want to test a strategy before they trust it.
product_trading_platform_audience.description: Who the Trading Platform is for, one sentence.

product_trading_platform_detail_1.message: The Trading Platform runs trend-following strategies, such as the Turtle rules, on many stocks in parallel.
product_trading_platform_detail_1.description: Trading Platform page, paragraph 1 of 3. The Turtle rules are a known trading system.

product_trading_platform_detail_2.message: Reinforcement learning tunes the settings for each stock, including the time scale on which its signals are most reliable.

product_trading_platform_detail_3.message: It trades on paper only, and nothing here is investment advice.
product_trading_platform_detail_3.description: Trading Platform page, paragraph 3 of 3: simulated trading only; legal disclaimer.
